criteria_location: POSITION STATEMENT is 320 lines (pp.2-12): a general rule, a documentation rule, a 'cosmetic' list, a 'Summary of Evidence' (4 paragraphs), 'Examples of Reconstructive Procedures (Not all inclusive)', nerve-allograft pathways I/II/III, 'Examples of Cosmetic Procedures (Not all inclusive)', and a non-covered code list. Many entries just 'Refer to' other policies.
procedures_covered: Reconstructive surgery generally (dozens of example procedures: brachioplasty, lifts, keloid, otoplasty, rhinoplasty, scar surgery, vascular birthmarks...)
Cosmetic examples (not covered; dozens of entries)
Non-covered CPT/HCPCS: 15828, 15829, 17380, 69090, 69300, Q2026; J0591 may be cosmetic

k_of_n.quote: when the criteria in one of the following categories I, II, or III are met

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Cosmetic list as exclusion: 'Surgery and related services are considered cosmetic in nature and is generally a contract exclusion for the following indications'; 'Brachioplasty (arm lift) do not meet the definition of medical necessity when done for aesthetic improvement'.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Revision of cosmetic procedure is itself cosmetic: 'Revision of a condition, for which the primary procedure was considered cosmetic'. Nerve injury >1 year goes to medical director.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Brachioplasty (arm lift) meets the definition of medical necessity when done in the presence of a functional impairment cause directly by the excess skin (...) and the functional impairment is refractory to 3 months of continuous medical therapy (...) and the procedure is expected to restore or improve the functional impairment.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Three conjuncts joined by lower-case 'and' in a run-on sentence with nested parentheses.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: III. There is a history of a known reasonable mechanism of injury ... and the nerve injury occurred within the last year (Medical necessity for nerve injuries greater than one year require review by a medical director ...) for the following: Sensory nerves: ... OR Motor nerves: ... OR Motor or sensory nerves: Nerve lesion ... ALL of the following
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Category III's trailing OR groups sit at a different indent than the I/II/III numerals; the ALL at the end could bind to the last OR branch only.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Loss of function determined by one of the following: Abnormal 2-point discrimination ... Patient self-report symptoms
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Self-reported symptoms count as a qualifying test; no AND/OR printed.

requirement_kinds.quote: excess skin is interfering with activities of daily living or causing persistent dermatitis, cellulitis, skin ulcerations
refractory to 3 months of continuous medical therapy (e.g., topical or systemic treatments for infection)

physician history and physical, physician operative report, pathology report, and attending physician visit notes that include documentation of medical indication. Photos are not required with the initial review.
Primary nerve tumor of the nerve or nerve resection is required for oncologic treatment
Nerve transfer is not an option (such as anterior interosseous nerve transfer).
Nerve lesion such as neuroma, documented by magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)
Medical necessity for nerve injuries greater than one year require review by a medical director

time_windows.quote: refractory to 3 months of continuous medical therapy
the nerve injury occurred within the last year

extraction_hazards: 320-line Position Statement mixing criteria, evidence summary (4 paragraphs of study text), 'Refer to' redirects and example lists.
Entries are bold-name run-ins in a bulleted list ('Breast bilateral reconstruction ...', 'Blepharoplasty eye lid ...'): the term and the rule are in one line without a delimiter.
Page-break mid-list: indentation changes (one-space margin) from a certain page onward.

Cross-reference IDs are inconsistent (Dermabrasion is cited as 02-12000-08 while its own number is 02-10000-08; Orthognathic Surgery and Prophylactic Mastectomy are both given as 02-12000-15 in Related Guidelines).
Nested pathways I./II./III. with 'OR' at the margin.
Mastectomy for GynecomastiaRefer ... (missing space) and other typos hinder matching.
Two LOINC tables with 4-column rows spanning many lines.
interesting_structures: A hybrid document: a router and exclusion list for many procedures, with only a few real criteria sets (brachioplasty/lifts, keloid, nerve allograft).
Documentation rule: 'Photos are not required with the initial review ... Florida Blue may request photos'.
Individual-consideration categories (congenital anomalies; strabismus >= 18 years) where no criteria exist.

fit_to_tree.why: Not one criteria tree but a catalogue; cosmetic vs reconstructive intent, 'individual consideration', and cross-policy redirects need human judgment. Only brachioplasty/lift and nerve-allograft entries are tree-shaped.
